question: In which year was Project Tiger launched in India to conserve the declining number of tigers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1973**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• **Project Tiger** was launched by the Government of India in **1973** to protect the endangered tiger population in India.

• The project is administered by the **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)**.

• It aims to ensure a viable population of Bengal tigers in their natural habitats and preserve areas of biological importance as a natural heritage for the people of India.

• The initiative started with nine tiger reserves, and today, the number has increased significantly, helping in the stabilization and increase of the tiger population in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)**

• NTCA was established in 2005, following the recommendations of the Tiger Task Force.

• It is a statutory body under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

• NTCA provides statutory authority to Project Tiger to ensure tiger conservation in India.

• It lays down standards for tiger conservation, ensures funding support, and monitors the implementation of the project.

• **Tiger Reserves in India**

• The initial nine tiger reserves established under Project Tiger included Jim Corbett, Bandipur, Kanha, Manas, Melghat, Palamau, Ranthambore, Similipal, and Sunderbans.

• As of 2023, India has over 50 tiger reserves spread across various states.

• These reserves are categorized as core and buffer areas, with the core areas being strictly protected for the tigers and other wildlife.

• Buffer areas promote co-existence between wildlife and human activity, ensuring minimal disturbance to the core habitat.

• **Role of Local Communities**

• Local communities play a crucial role in the success of tiger conservation efforts.

• Several initiatives aim to involve local populations in conservation activities through eco-development programs and employment opportunities.

• Awareness campaigns and education programs are conducted to highlight the importance of tiger conservation.

• Involving local communities helps in garnering support for conservation efforts and reduces human-wildlife conflicts.
